name: Default
shortDescription: DB Browser for SQLite desktop app streamed to the browser, for creating, browsing and editing SQLite database files kept on a persistent volume.

alerts.message: Sign in with the CUSTOM_USER and PASSWORD values from the environment. This basic auth is the only protection, and the web desktop includes a terminal with sudo inside the container. Save databases under /config so they persist.
HTTPS is required; the browser desktop does not work over plain HTTP.
